newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 8.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- New nuclear regulatory body may replace the state-run Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corp.
-- Trade ministry plans to introduce standard for industrial waste.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd provided 150 million yen to two other corporate racketeers.
-- Local governments worry about outbreak of E. coli O-157 in private homes.
-- Anti-food poisoning measures still not enough for school lunches.
